issues.explanation: Only the user-side cascade is asserted (membership count goes to 0 after user delete); no test deletes an entity to prove memberships cascade on entity delete as the migration claims.
No Keep-a-Changelog entry was added under [Unreleased] even though conventions.md requires one for every change.

conventions.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_000000_create_entities_table.php:412 and 2026_10_29_000001_create_entity_memberships_table.php:457 have reversible down(); app/Models/Entity.php:20 and EntityMembership.php:75 use #[Fillable] matching app/Models/User.php sibling style; docs/database-schema.md:468,511-513 updated; but CHANGELOG.md untouched

readability.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:29-36 isOwnerOrAdmin helper; app/Models/User.php:169 membershipFor; small focused methods, clear names, no dead code

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_000001_create_entity_memberships_table.php:443-449 owner_seq storedAs CASE WHEN role='owner' plus entity_memberships_one_owner index; app/Models/Entity.php:52-56 owner() HasOne where role owner; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:264-287 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:216-237 match all authorization rules; docs/database-schema.md:502,511 remove owner_membership_id

scope.evidence: All 11 files serve the task: 4 models/enum, 2 policies, 2 migrations, 2 factories, docs/database-schema.md update, tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php; no routes, pages, or unrelated refactors

security.evidence: app/Policies/EntityMembershipPolicy.php:228 returns false for owner membership delete before self-removal check; app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:270-287 deny non-members; #[Fillable] excludes owner_seq; no Livewire/client-trust issues

simplicity.evidence: app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:289 and EntityMembershipPolicy.php:239 share one private isOwnerOrAdmin helper instead of duplicating role checks; no service layers or speculative abstractions

tests.evidence: tests/Feature/EntityModelTest.php:554-562 slug/soft-delete, 611-621 second-owner plus promotion rejection, 634-644 duplicate-membership plus user-cascade, 646-705 entity/membership policy matrix including outsider and other-entity admin; entity-side cascade not covered

review.summary: Implements entities, memberships with DB-enforced single owner, models, enum, policies, factories and docs with a thorough Pest suite. Missing only an entity-side cascade test and a CHANGELOG entry, so approve with nits.
